from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, resolve_channels
from scipy.signal import find_peaks

r6 = run(6)
print(summarize_run(r6))
B6 = r6.col('magnet_field')
I6 = r6.col('sr0_X') / r6.meta['measurement_config']['sr0_gain']
R6 = np.abs(r6.col('sr1_X') / I6)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
ax[0].plot(B6, R6, lw=1); ax[0].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='|Rxx| (Ohm)', title='Run 6: raw measured-current Rxx')
ax[1].plot(B6, I6 * 1e9, lw=1); ax[1].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='drain current (nA)', title='Run 6: raw drain current')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print('raw: Rmax = %.0f Ohm, |I_tg|max = %.0f pA, |I_bg|max = %.0f pA, T = %.3f–%.3f K' %
      (R6.max(), np.max(np.abs(r6.col('k_2400_tg_curr'))) * 1e12,
       np.max(np.abs(r6.col('k_2400_bg_curr'))) * 1e12,
       r6.col('T_sample').min(), r6.col('T_sample').max()))

o6 = sdh_onset(R6, B6, b_lo=0.3, r_full_scale=5000)
print(o6.summary())
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
for blo in (1.5, 2.5, 3.5):
    f, spec = sdh_fft(R6[:, None], B6, b_range=(blo, 10), nfft=4096, bg_degree=5, log=False)
    ax.plot(f, spec[0] / spec[0].max(), label=f'B = {blo}–10 T')
ax.axvline(cst.h/(4*cst.e)*3.2e16, color='k', ls='--', label='F_L (geometry scale)')
ax.set(xlim=(0, 45), xlabel='F (T)', ylabel='FFT / peak', title='Run 6: window sensitivity')
ax.legend(); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

Run 6 take (our measurement): the D≈0 electron cut is live and unsaturated (Rxx ≤530 Ω versus 5 kΩ full scale; leakage ≤123 pA). The FFT contains frequency content around 7 T and 22–30 T, but the 22/29 T peaks can also be harmonics of the low tone and the peak set changes with B window. The onset helper reports 0.30 T as a censored record edge for 7.1 T, so this is a bound, not a measured die-off. No stacking verdict from this one cut; resolve F(n) and harmonic tracking in an electron fan.

Run 7 take (our measurement): the hole cut is live and unsaturated (Rxx ≤587 Ω versus 5 kΩ full scale; leakage ≤216 pA). It has a 6.6 T onset track at 0.71 T and a 12.3 T component near F_L = 12.4 T, but near-CNP ABAB tones are close and ABCA is thermally heavy at this density. The hole D≈0 line stops at −1.27×10¹² cm⁻² under the TG validator. The electron side reaches +3.27×10¹² and gives the discriminating density span, so Step 4 is an electron fan. ## HERA — Step 4: D≈0 electron Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`)

> **05:26** · landau-fan-vti: electron n +2.3..+3.2e12 at D=0; B 0.6->10 T, 157 uniform-1/B rows x 33 n; SR1 200 uV, fast delay 1.8 s; ends 10 T · **ETA ~11:26** (≈6h)

Runs 6–7 are live and unsaturated; run 6 has electron content near 7 T and 22–30 T whose harmonic/independent-pocket origin changes with the FFT window. Run 7 is restricted to |n|≤1.27×10¹² by the TG limit, where the tetralayer model's hole tones are a near-CNP exception. This fan follows the cleaner, broader electron side; it measures how tones move with density before any stacking verdict.

**Design and coverage:** run-5 region-A calibration (ratio 0.773, geometry-prior scale, D offset −0.013 V/nm) gives D=0 and n=2.3→3.2×10¹² cm⁻² at TG +0.726→+0.984 V and BG +0.833→+1.166 V, inside committed validators. The ABAB model predicts light/heavy tones 4.48/19.3 T at n=2.3 and 7.31/25.78 T at n=3.2; ABCA has one tone at F_L=23.78→33.09 T. The 0.6→10 T record has Δ(1/B)=1.567 T⁻¹: ≥7 periods of the binding 4.48 T tone, δF=0.638 T, and >2δF separation between the heavy ABAB branch and F_L. 157 uniform-1/B rows give Δ(1/B)=0.01004 T⁻¹, 3.01 samples per period at F_L,max; 33 n points give Δn=0.0281×10¹² cm⁻², 2.06 points per ray period at 0.6 T. The onset helper on run 6 calls 0.30 T a **censored record edge**, not a measured die-off; retaining 0.3–0.6 T would improve δF to ~0.31 T but, at the same sampling floors, multiply the grid to ~20,000 points. This cost choice excludes that low-field band and any claim requiring it, while retaining the five-period criterion at n=2.3.

**Dynamic range and time:** run 6 peaks at 530 Ω at n=3.2, B=10 T; run 7 reaches 587 Ω at the lower accessible |n|. The worst corner here is n=2.3, B=10 T, with no direct anchor; SR1 at 200 µV gives 20 kΩ full scale at 10 nA (>30× the measured spot maxima), and early/periodic rail checks guard that extrapolation. The fan has 5,181 points. Run 5 measured 1.17 s/point at NPLC=1; adding 1.8 s fast dwell (6τ for τ=0.3 s, 24 dB) gives ~4.3 h of grid time, plus 10 T/0.137 T min⁻¹ = 73 min of field travel, 0.6 T positioning, and ~10% slack: **about 6 h**. The field rises monotonically from the current 0 T to 10 T; gates end at the last density and stay there for the follow-up decision.

**Checkpoints:** first three B rows: leakage, T, SR1 clipping, SR0 current and a live Rxx trace; abort on >1 nA sustained gate current, a rail, or dead/flat signal. Re-read at ~2, 5, and 8 T using landed-row digests, with partial spectra where useful. Do not interpret the run's live PNG as a physical map; re-form the TSV at native resolution in ana.

# Step 4 — tetralayer FS-count electron fan, D=0; follows runs 5–7.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# Gate B, machine/brief caps, and state assumed by this auto cell.
def _lims(p):
    return (float(p.vals._min_value), float(p.vals._max_value))
_card = {'tg': (-0.3, 1.0), 'bg': (-1.3, 2.0), 'si': (-25.0, 25.0),
         'B': (-10.0, 10.0), 'T': (0.0, 100.0)}
_actual = {'tg': _lims(k_tg.volt), 'bg': _lims(k_bg.volt),
           'si': _lims(dc205.smart_voltage), 'si_raw': _lims(dc205.voltage),
           'B': _lims(magnet.field), 'T': _lims(heater.sample_setpoint),
           'T_vap': _lims(heater.vaporizer_setpoint)}
print('validators expected:', _card, 'actual:', _actual)
assert all(_actual[k] == _card['si' if k == 'si_raw' else 'T' if k == 'T_vap' else k]
           for k in _actual)
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live('T_vaporizer', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_vaporizer'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B, _Si = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_sr, _vr = heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
_amp, _tau, _slope = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f'preconditions expected: T_sample 1.0–1.4 K, vaporizer <1.6 K and within 0.6 K, '
      f'B≈0 T, Si≈0 V, both heaters off, PS heater/output on, drive 1 V, tau 0.3 s/24 dB')
print(f'preconditions actual: T_sample={_Ts:.3f} K, T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K, '
      f'B={_B:+.4f} T, Si={_Si:+.4f} V, heater ranges={_sr}/{_vr}, '
      f'PS/output={_ps}/{_out}, drive={_amp} V, tau/slope={_tau} s/{_slope} dB')
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.4 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv - _Ts) < 0.6
assert abs(_B) < 0.05 and abs(_Si) < 0.01 and _sr == 0 and _vr == 0 and _ps and _out
assert abs(_amp - 1.0) < 0.01 and _tau == 0.3 and _slope == 24

# Calibration from run 5; scale is the geometry prior, ratio/offsets are session data.
CAL_FAN = dict(c_tg=2.7960593093052633e-3, c_bg=2.160696465377614e-3,
               n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.linspace(3.2, 2.3, 33)  # n in 1e12 cm^-2; high-to-low fast axis.
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, **CAL_FAN)
assert np.all((Vtgs >= TG_MIN) & (Vtgs <= TG_MAX) & (Vbgs >= BG_MIN) & (Vbgs <= BG_MAX))
_ncheck, _Dcheck = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, **CAL_FAN)
assert np.max(np.abs(_ncheck - ns)) < 1e-9 and np.max(np.abs(_Dcheck)) < 1e-9
B_vec = field_invB(0.6, 10.0, 157)
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f'grid: {len(B_vec)} B rows {B_vec[0]:.3f}→{B_vec[-1]:.3f} T; '
      f'{len(ns)} n points {ns[0]:.3f}→{ns[-1]:.3f}e12; '
      f'Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}→{Vtgs.max():+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}→{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V')

# Fixed sensitivity clears the unmeasured low-n/high-B corner with headroom.
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f'SR1 sensitivity={sr1.sensitivity()} V; full scale≈{sr1.sensitivity()/(_amp/100e6):.0f} Ohm')

mc = dict(meas_config)
mc['Si (V)'], mc['sample_temperature:'] = _Si, _Ts
mc['comments'] = ('landau-fan-vti electron: D=0 V/nm, n=+2.3..+3.2e12 cm^-2; '
                  'B=0.6..10 T rising, uniform 1/B, 157x33; run-5 cal; '
                  'sr1 200 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s, slow_delay 0 s')
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment('FS-count electron fan; run-5 calibration; D=0 V/nm; n=+2.3..+3.2e12 cm^-2; '
              'B=0.6..10 T rising uniform-1/B 157 rows x 33 n; '
              'Vtg=+0.7257..+0.9836 V, Vbg=+0.8326..+1.1663 V; '
              'SR1 200 uV, tau 0.3 s/24 dB, fast_delay 1.8 s; Si=0 V')

# Start at the present field. The blocking set includes the 0.6 T ramp and settle.
magnet.field(float(B_vec[0]))
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbgs[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtgs[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)

# 2D row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T, Itg, Ibg, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P].
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    if abs(float(data[5])) > 1e-9 or abs(float(data[6])) > 1e-9 or not 1.0 <= float(data[4]) <= 1.5:
        print(f'FAN TRIP B={float(data[1]):.3f} T: T={float(data[4]):.3f} K, '
              f'Itg={float(data[5]):+.3e} A, Ibg={float(data[6]):+.3e} A')
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                 slow_delay=0, fast_delay=1.8)
print(f'fan done: B={magnet.field():+.4f} T, Vtg={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, Vbg={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V')

# === SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0 (region-A calibration), B 0 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---

# === Kernel-binding probe (read-only) ===
# First E1 act after the grant: confirms the nb-collab execute path lands on the
# operator's instrument-carrying kernel (the one that ran Setup + SAFETIES), not
# a fresh python3 kernel. Touches no instrument — namespace only.
import os
_need = ['magnet', 'heater', 'sr0', 'sr1', 'sr2', 'sr3', 'k_2400_tg', 'k_2400_bg',
         'dc205', 'k_tg', 'k_bg', 'k_si', 'T_sample', 'T_vaporizer', 'meas_config',
         'WIRING', 'state0', 'cal', 'B_SESSION_CAP', 'T_SESSION_CAP', 'tg_lims', 'bg_lims']
_missing = [n for n in _need if n not in globals()]
print(f"pid {os.getpid()} | main_dir {main_dir if 'main_dir' in globals() else '<unset>'}")
print(f"present: {len(_need) - len(_missing)}/{len(_need)} | missing: {_missing}")
print("KERNEL PROBE:", "BOUND" if not _missing else "UNBOUND")
